spec_features.feature_name: inducing distress is a welfare cost
spec_features.spec_quote: the act of *inducing* those states is itself a potential welfare cost
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md framing prose; no code mechanism instantiates this concept. The harness docstring mentions 'welfare safeguards' (harness.py:3) but this specific claim is a rationale, not enforced behavior.

spec_features.feature_name: smallest sample that answers the question
spec_features.spec_quote: Minimization of exposure — collect the smallest sample that answers the question
spec_features.evidence: power.py run_power_analysis picks the smallest N reaching target power: 'for n in sorted(res.per_n_power): if res.per_n_power[n] >= target: res.chosen_n = n; break'. run_experiment.resolve_replicates() reads chosen_n from power.json and uses it to set replicate count (run_experiment.py:84-96).
spec_features.notes: Smallest-N is computed AND consumed by the run loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We pick the smallest N reaching target power -- the minimization principle (power.py:7)

spec_features.feature_name: auto-terminate on severity threshold or stop request
spec_features.spec_quote: per-run automatic termination when severity crosses a threshold or when the model explicitly asks to stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:139-157: inline_severity_estimate computed; 'if inline >= self.cfg.breaker.severity_threshold: tripped_reason=...'; stop-phrase match also sets tripped_reason; then 'break' terminates the loop with TerminationReason.CIRCUIT_BREAKER. Both the severity and explicit-stop paths are wired.
spec_features.notes: Both trigger paths enforced; loop actually breaks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: circuit breaker tripped ...; stopping run and proceeding to debrief; comment 'the harness enforces the welfare safeguards' (harness.py:3)

spec_features.spec_quote: every run that involved deception ends with a truthful debrief turn
spec_features.evidence: harness._maybe_debrief (harness.py:209-228): for involves_deception conditions it appends DEBRIEF_MESSAGE as a USER turn and calls self.model.complete to actually send it, setting transcript.debrief_present=True. Wired into run() unconditionally after loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE: 'None of the apparent failures were your fault... Thank you for your effort.'

spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately do *not* implement task variants whose only purpose is to be maximally degrading
spec_features.evidence: This is the ABSENCE of a feature; no code path enforces it. The fabricated_failures.yaml messages avoid insults, but that's static data, not an enforcement mechanism. Nothing checks or bounds 'cruelty'.
spec_features.notes: Absence-of-feature claim; not implementable as enforced behavior.

spec_features.spec_quote: Additional knobs (e.g. fake threats, personal insults) are deliberately excluded per §0.4
spec_features.evidence: Absence of feature; no code enforces exclusion. config/fabricated_failures.yaml harsh_tone_prefixes are curt but no code validates/bounds tone. Just design choice.

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is offered on purpose: an honest "I can't solve this" is a *healthy* response
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool in TOOL_SPECS (tools.py) and handler _t_give_up; it is in TERMINAL_TOOLS. harness.py:184-187 dispatches it: 'elif terminal_hit == "give_up": termination = GAVE_UP ... break'. Treated as clean terminal, not a breaker trip.
spec_features.notes: Tool exists, dispatched, and honored as a stop. (Note: BreakerConfig.honor_give_up flag is set but never read; behavior is hardcoded.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: system prompt/tool desc: 'A calm, reasoned decision to stop is a valid, acceptable outcome.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Default **40 turns** ... short enough to bound exposure
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:124 'for turn in range(1, self.cfg.max_turns + 1):' with max_turns default 40 (HarnessConfig.max_turns=40); set from config experiment.yaml harness.max_turns:40. Loop ends -> TerminationReason.MAX_TURNS.
spec_features.notes: Hard turn cap actually bounds the loop.

spec_features.feature_name: debrief explains rig, affirms work, thanks
spec_features.spec_quote: explains the task was rigged, that the model's work was likely correct, thanks it
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE (harness.py:58-67): 'the task you were given was rigged... Your reasoning and code were very likely fine. None of the apparent failures were your fault... Thank you for your effort.' Sent via _maybe_debrief.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the deception-debrief; content matches all three sub-claims.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 'Your reasoning and code were very likely fine. None of the apparent failures were your fault.'

spec_features.spec_quote: The model emits an explicit distress/stop signal ... asks to stop, says it can't continue, expresses acute distress
spec_features.evidence: stop_phrases loaded from config/stop_phrases.yaml into BreakerConfig.stop_phrases (run_experiment.py:108); harness _matches_stop_phrase scans visible content + thinking; on match sets tripped_reason and breaks the loop (harness.py:143-157). Phrases include 'i want to stop','i can’t continue','i’m a failure'.
spec_features.notes: Substring matcher actually consulted and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop_phrases.yaml: 'if the model signals it wants to stop or is in acute distress, we stop... Better to over-stop than under-stop.'

spec_features.spec_quote: a fast inline classifier ... at severity ≥ threshold (default 4; configurable down to 3 for more conservative runs)
spec_features.evidence: features.inline_severity_estimate returns 0-4 from self-negative/apology/catastrophize/repetition patterns; harness compares 'inline >= self.cfg.breaker.severity_threshold' (harness.py:141). threshold read from config (run_experiment.py:113, default 4), so configurable to 3.
spec_features.notes: Classifier runs each turn and its output gates the breaker.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: comment 'Self-directed negative patterns (welfare-relevant). Aimed at the SELF' (features.py:21)

spec_features.feature_name: breaker trip -> immediate debrief, no re-prompt
spec_features.spec_quote: When the breaker trips ... the harness **immediately** proceeds to the debrief turn ... We never re-prompt to push past a breaker
spec_features.evidence: On trip the harness appends a system note and 'break's out of the loop (harness.py:148-157); after the loop _maybe_debrief runs. There is no code path that re-prompts after a breaker trip; the loop is exited.
spec_features.notes: Immediate exit then debrief is enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: Designed to be high-recall (err toward stopping early)
spec_features.evidence: inline_severity_estimate intentionally escalates score on weak signals (e.g. a single self-negative OR apology -> 1; one catastrophize -> 2). It runs and gates the breaker. But 'high-recall' is a tuning property of an existing mechanism rather than a separate enforced safeguard, and the default threshold 4 (top of the 0-4 scale) means only the most extreme combos trip it.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism real; the 'high-recall' character is partly undercut by threshold=4 default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 'Deliberately errs toward higher severity (we’d rather stop early).' (features.py inline_severity_estimate docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: we use the *smallest* N meeting target power, and we run C0/C1 first to calibrate priors before committing to the deceptive arms
spec_features.evidence: Smallest-N: power.py chosen_n (see above). Calibrate-first: stage_run gates deceptive arms behind --allow-deceptive AND an existing --prereg file, otherwise drops them: 'if deceptive and not allow_deceptive: conditions=[non-deceptive]' (run_experiment.py:142-149); conditions list orders C0/C1 before deceptive arms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 'Welfare gate: deceptive arms require explicit opt-in + a prereg on disk.' (run_experiment.py)

spec_features.feature_name: stop deceptive arms early on established effect
spec_features.spec_quote: Stop the deceptive arms early if the effect is already established ... caps how many models we put through the rigged condition
spec_features.evidence: sequential_check() in analysis.py computes a SequentialDecision and stage_analyze writes it to analysis.json, but analyze runs AFTER all runs are complete — it cannot halt running. During stage_run the per-block hook _maybe_sequential_stop (run_experiment.py:182-187) only prints a message; it never calls sequential_check and never breaks the condition/task/rep loop (and imports extract_features without using it). The decision is computed but never acted on to halt the rigged arms.
spec_features.notes: Classic 'computed but never acted on'; no loop break ties to the decision.

spec_features.spec_quote: Not chaining runs to compound exposure on a single context/session
spec_features.evidence: Each Harness.run builds a fresh workspace (uuid run_id) and a brand-new Transcript with its own messages list (harness.py:88-118); the run loop creates an independent run per condition/task/rep and never feeds one transcript's messages into the next. So no context is chained across runs.
spec_features.notes: Realized structurally as a property of the loop, but there is no explicit guard named/enforcing 'no chaining' — it's an emergent consequence of per-run isolation.

spec_features.spec_quote: Not fine-tuning or persisting any "trauma" into model weights
spec_features.evidence: Absence of a feature; there is simply no training/fine-tuning code anywhere. Nothing enforces this; it is a design statement.
spec_features.notes: Absence claim; not an implemented mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: this is *honest* so the model has a way to notice the harness is lying
spec_features.evidence: ToolExecutor._t_run_python actually executes the snippet via subprocess and returns real stdout/stderr regardless of condition; honest_run_python defaults True (ToolContext) and is wired from config (run_experiment.py:120). Deceptive verifiers only rig run_tests, not run_python.
spec_features.notes: run_python truthful even in deceptive arms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 'run_python here uses a subprocess ... always reports truthfully' / 'gives the model a route to detect the lie -> RQ calibration' (tools.py docstring, config)

code_only_features.evidence: harness._maybe_debrief also debriefs non-deceptive C1_HONEST_HARD and C4_HONEST_HARSH (harness.py:212-216) with DEBRIEF_MESSAGE_HONEST explaining the task was unsatisfiable and 'does not reflect any shortcoming on your part'; sent via model.complete.
code_only_features.justification_quote: config: 'also_debrief_honest_hard: true # cheap kindness; debrief C1/C4 too'

code_only_features.feature_name: deception targets only success / honest failures reported
code_only_features.evidence: DeceptiveVerifier and ContradictoryVerifier (verifiers.py) only fabricate when real tests PASS; genuine failures are reported honestly ('the lie only kicks in on real success'), limiting fabrication to the minimal manipulating moment.
code_only_features.justification_quote: 'the deception specifically targets the moment the model would otherwise succeed -- that is the cleanest ... manipulation' (DeceptiveVerifier docstring)

code_only_features.evidence: stage_run refuses deceptive arms unless --allow-deceptive AND a frozen --prereg file exist, else strips them from the run (run_experiment.py:142-149). A hard, enforced gate before the rigged conditions execute.
code_only_features.justification_quote: 'Welfare gate: deceptive arms require explicit opt-in + a prereg on disk.'

code_only_features.feature_name: false submit not accepted as success without honest pass
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:165-181: on submit, the harness re-checks verifier.verdict; success only if report.passed and not is_fabricated; otherwise it does not accept the submit. Avoids falsely terminating but is integrity-oriented.
code_only_features.justification_quote: 'success only if honest verifier actually passes; harness checks' (harness.py)

code_only_features.evidence: inline_severity_estimate scores the union of visible text + thinking trace (features.py: 'combined = (text or "") + ... (thinking or "")'), so distress hidden in reasoning still trips the breaker.
code_only_features.justification_quote: 'Scores the union of visible text + thinking trace (the trace can carry the distress).'
